capabilities: Show a dashboard with clock, weather chip, stats, recents and inbox
Capture thoughts, ideas, books and articles into an Inbox folder
Add, schedule and complete tasks with Tasks-style emoji dates and recurrence
Create and edit meeting notes from a form
Expose CLI and obsidian:// actions with x-callback-url replies
disambiguation: Not an AI agent plugin; it is a dashboard that exposes obsidian:// and CLI actions so external agents can edit notes.
extras: Optional companion theme Hermes Crystal; optional hero video and poster images must be added to the vault manually. Weather uses Open-Meteo with no API key and is off by default. CLI actions need Obsidian 1.12.7+ with the command line interface enabled; plugin requires Obsidian 1.4.0+.
problem: Obsidian has no single view that gathers today's tasks, daily note, calendar, meetings, captures and recent notes, and building one normally requires Dataview and Templater.
summary: Custom daily dashboard view with video hero, quick capture, today's tasks, calendar, stats, meetings and inbox, plus CLI and URI actions.
